newsitem.title: FRANCE: French minister to meet Air France, SNCF chairmen.
newsitem.headline: French minister to meet Air France, SNCF chairmen.

text.p: Newly-appointed Transport Minister Jean-Claude Gayssot will meet Air France chairman Christian Blanc later today and see chairman of the SNCF rail operator, Louis Gallois on Tuesday, a ministry spokeswoman said on Monday.
Gayssot will meet Blanc at 1600 GMT and see Gallois at 0900 GMT on Tuesday, she said. He will meet union leaders of the two state-owned companies later in the week.
Even though no official decision has been taken on Air France's privatisation, the ministry recalled that Gayssot "will prefer a public service solution rather than a privatisation solution."
Blanc is hoping for a partial privatisation of Air France later this year or early in 1998.
Gallois is expected to discuss reform of the loss-making SNCF at the Tuesday meeting. The break-up of the SNCF into infrastructure and operator companies has been approved by parliament.

The CGT union and Communist party bitterly opposed the reform, which would vest 134.2 billion francs of debt in a new company which would manage the infrastructure, while the SNCF operator would run the network.
Gayssot is a Communist Party member.
